profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer & Architect | Distributed Systems | Agentic AI Strategy & Governance
profile.summary:
I’ve spent the last 15+ years building distributed systems that have to work.
That includes large-scale data platforms moving billions of events, and now software that supports clinical trials for life-saving treatments.

Lately, I’ve been spending a lot of time thinking about what it takes to operate AI agents safely in production, especially as these systems become longer-lived and more embedded in real workflows.

What I do (Paradigm Health)

I’m currently a Staff Engineer and Tech Lead on a high-compliance, AI-powered EMR-to-EDC platform.

I work closely with my team on the design and delivery of complex clinical data workflows in a strict regulatory environment (CFR Part 11), with an emphasis on enabling agent-assisted development workflows that make sense for regulated systems.

Interests

I’m interested in autonomous systems with a focus on governance, observability, and auditability over time.

I write about AI, architecture, trust, and governance at tonyfoster.dev.

Background:
 • 15+ years building cloud-native systems on AWS and GCP (Kafka, Kubernetes, TypeScript/Node.js, C#, Kotlin/Java, Terraform)
 • Security-first mindset with a heavy emphasis on observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki)
 • Tech lead experience on high-compliance teams, helping engineers adapt existing CI/CD and operational practices to an agentic world without losing control

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
●  ​ Leading grassroots AI DevEx adoption across multiple teams, running enablement sessions, shaping internal tooling standards, and serving as a primary technical voice driving engineering culture change around AI practices.

●  Owning technical vision for the AI-powered Data Extraction and Automated EHR-to-EDC platform, actively shaping architecture across a high-compliance ecosystem where source EHR data, clinical trial integrity, and regulatory submission accuracy are all on the line, primarily serving oncology research.

●  Owning the compliance engineering strategy, shaping the systems that protect PHI, enforce data lineage, and provide immutable auditing across services to satisfy HIPAA and CFR Part 11 requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Staff Management · Software Infrastructure · Agentic AI Development · Agentic Workflows · Agentic Automation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●  Built and maintained Curipod’s interactive, AI-native curriculum & student-participation platform, Next.js frontend with a TypeScript/Koa backend over HTTP (Node.js) and WebSockets (Socket.IO) on GCP,leveraging the Vercel AI SDK and scaling to hundreds of thousands of teachers and students worldwide each day.

●  Lifted signup conversion to 96% (from 90%) by redesigning onboarding and running analytics-driven experiments.

●  Established a culture of observability and, leveraging OpenTelemetry, instrumented HTTP and WebSocket services to monitor AI-agent and LLM performance; expanded infrastructure monitoring and shipped self-serve debug dashboards, accelerating feedback loops and product iteration.

●  Automated release processes, removing manual steps and saving ~7 engineering weeks per year.

●  Ran in-person and remote user tests with teachers and students; partnered with product/design to turn insights into specs and shipped features more quickly.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · TypeScript · Next.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platforms Team Lead
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
●  Improved platform observability, resulting in a 2–3x decrease in debug time, by creating TypeScript instrumentation libraries and using Terraform to provision supporting infrastructure. Processing 500+ GB of log, metrics, and tracing data monthly.

●  Built and managed the SkySpecs data streaming platform leveraging PostgreSQL, Kafka Connect, and RedPanda, with Kafka Connect deployed on Kubernetes using Helm. The platform streams billions of events across services and into a data warehouse, delivering critical turbine condition data to customers.

●  Designed and built a notifications system our SkySpecs data streaming platform in collaboration with product management, leveraging an event-driven architecture. Written in TypeScript and deployed with Terraform, the system alerts customers of critical wind turbine damage.

●  Audited AWS infrastructure and source code for security vulnerabilities in collaboration with the information security team, contributing to the attainment of ISO 27001 certification. Improvements included enhanced network security with monitoring and the implementation of software dependency and container image scanning.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · TypeScript · Software Architecture · Cloud Services · SaaS Development · Prototyping · Terraform · Product Road Mapping · DevOps · Startups · Distributed Systems · Software Engineering · JavaScript · docker

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
●  Enabled Ripple Science to scale their HIPAA-compliant clinical research participant management software for enterprise users, helping secure contracts with record-setting ARR by migrating their user authentication stack to Amazon Cognito. Designed the solution using Node.js and AWS Lambda; provisioned infrastructure with Terraform.

●  Achieved a 98% improvement in MongoDB query times for Ripple Science by refactoring the schema and rewriting aggregation pipelines, significantly reducing system resource usage and resolving critical performance bottlenecks.

●  Reduced deployment-related issues and regressions at Ripple Science by introducing canary deployments, achieving a 90% decline in deployment-related problems such as poor performance, bugs, and downtime.

●  Developed a participant communication framework in JavaScript, leveraging SendGrid and Twilio APIs for text and email communication to minimize attrition and maximize adherence to trial protocols. This solution helped Ripple Science achieve a 96% clinical trial retention rate, far exceeding the industry standard of ~70%.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Cloud Services · SaaS Development · Prototyping · Startups · Distributed Systems · Software Engineering · React.js · JavaScript · docker

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
●  Reduced supply chain model development time from 3–6 months to minutes by designing a system for automatic model generation. Collaborated with stakeholders across product management and engineering to ensure all functional and non-functional requirements were met.

●  Increased deployment speed and confidence in software releases by developing an integration test framework in C# using .NET Core. Collaborated with engineers across the llama.ai platform to ensure ease of use and to improve the developer experience, leading to widespread adoption.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Cloud Services · Software Testing · SaaS Development · Prototyping · Product Road Mapping · Integration Testing · Developer Experience

company.name: Coupa Supply Chain, powered by LLamasoft
Coupa Supply Chain, powered by LLamasoft

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
●  Architected data ingestion APIs using C# (.NET Core) on Kubernetes with the Apigee API gateway for authentication and caching. Built a data ingestion pipeline on Apache Kafka, enabling LLamasoft to onboard a Fortune 500 industrial giant and a major international grocery chain.

●  Created incident management protocols for the llama.ai platform by leading the adoption of processes inspired by the Atlassian Incident Management handbook. Mentored engineering leaders on implementation and proper root cause analysis, establishing organized processes for handling incidents.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Simulation Platform (ESP)
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
●  Led full-stack engineering for the Enterprise Simulation Platform application, featuring a React-based frontend and a C# (.NET Core) backend deployed to Kubernetes. Integrated embedded Tableau Server dashboards to provide customers with actionable insights from their supply chain data.

●  Mentored a team of cross-functional interns, leading them through the delivery of a prototype for embedded analytics software. Guided them in requirements gathering, agile development practices, and deployment automation, resulting in a highly praised final product.
